integrity: The proof is symbolic. Its only nonstandard imported ingredients are the published matrix identity for Delta and the stated simplicity/matrix-closure theorems for sqrt-Delta-fine rings; no experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles every matrix size n>=2 but not the base-ring case n=1. The current-source full PDF was unavailable through the open full-text route used for comparison, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed duplicate corollary in that source.
title: Matrix amplification collapses \(\sqrt{\Delta}\)-fineness to fineness
